display.title: Episode 184: Rabbi Akiva's Negel Vasser and the Drunken Father (The Three Weeks)
display.summary_short: During the Three Weeks: Torah and mitzvos defeat the yetzer hara, Rabbi Akiva uses his only water for negel vasser, and a story with no happy ending about copying bad ways.
display.summary_long: Broadcast during the Three Weeks of 5745. Uncle Yossi invites children to join Tzivos Hashem and explains that its 'enemy' is the yetzer hara, which grows weaker with every bit of Torah and mitzvos until it surrenders before Moshiach comes. A girl recites the Shema, followed by an air-conditioner commercial. Story time: Rabbi Akiva, jailed for teaching Torah and given no water for three days, uses his jug of water to wash negel vasser and make a brachah. Amazed, the ruler frees him and makes him an advisor. Uncle Yossi then explains Rabbi Akiva's teaching that loving your fellow as yourself is a great rule of the Torah, and the Alter Rebbe's words that Ahavas Yisroel leads to Ahavas Hashem, which is so needed in the Three Weeks. A second story 'has no happy ending': Naftali, ashamed of his father's drinking, shows him a drunk lying in the street, but his father only asks where to get such a good drink. The Torah shows us the ways of other nations only so that we will not copy them. The show ends by encouraging listeners to sign up friends as new members.
display.lesson: Keep the mitzvos even when it is hard, love every Jew, and learn from bad examples what not to do.

date.note: 'In the middle of the Three Weeks'; the week after episode 183 (13 Tammuz 5745). Most of the content repeats episode 135 (Three Weeks 5744).
